response.changelog:
Pixel OS v1.5.2 — Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Pure iOS 26 Left-Right Home Screen Navigation (No Vertical Slide-Up Drawer): Removes the vertical slide-up All Apps drawer gesture on Home Screen & Dock, automatically places all existing and newly installed system/user apps onto left-right Home Screen pages (0 duplicates, Page 0/Dock/Folders preserved), and morphs the Liquid Glass 'Q Search' capsule into real-time 90Hz iOS 26 page dots ('• •') during horizontal swipes
• Authentic 1:1 iOS 26 System & App Store Icon Suite: Locked v1.3 multi-plane Phone, Messages & Settings icons, Play Store -> 1:1 iOS 26 App Store, supersampled multi-plane system icons & official 1024x1024 iOS App Store icons across Default, Dark & Clear modes
• Lifted iOS 26 Concentric Icon-Cushion Liquid Glass Dock: Elevated dock bottom margin (62px / 23.6dp) aligned with iOS 26 SpringBoard thumb elevation, uniform 4-sided ~40px icon cushion & smooth continuous curved corners (R_dock = 96px, p = 2.65)
• Global Hidden Bottom Navigation Bar + Live Settings Toggle: Hides the bottom gesture pill globally by default while preserving 90Hz Home Bar gestures, with a live 'Show Bottom Navigation Bar' toggle in Settings -> Realme X2 Pro
